reports.title: Phibro Animal Health Corporation Reports First Quarter Results, Maintains Financial Guidance

guidance.heading: FISCAL YEAR 2027 FINANCIAL GUIDANCE
section: Our fiscal year 2027 financial guidance is as shown below, with our guidance maintained from the previous quarter. Year-over-year percentages are calculated using the midpoint of the guidance ranges.
● | Net sales of $1.55 billion to $1.60 billion, 4% growth
● | Net income of $122 million to $132 million, 27% growth
● | Adjusted EBITDA of $258 million to $268 million, 3% growth
● | Adjusted net income of $140 million to $147 million, 9% growth
● | Adjusted diluted EPS of $3.41 to $3.59, 9% growth
● | Adjusted effective income tax rate of ~20%
Guidance for GAAP measures assumes no additional foreign exchange (gains) losses for the year ending June 30, 2027.
